correctness.rationale: For unit-edge regular d-simplex, d>=3, the projection width equals max_{i!=j}<U,(e_i−e_j)/sqrt2> for Haar U in sum-zero d-space. Its high survival event is N=d(d+1) spherical caps. Distinct directed roots have inner products in {-1,-1/2,0,1/2}; first cap contacts at t=a=sqrt3/2, with exactly P=d(d+1)(d−1) unordered pairs having dot 1/2. Three pairwise-eligible roots share start or end vertex; sum vector length sqrt6 implies first positive triple overlap below b=sqrt(2/3). Hence through b<=t<=a inclusion–exclusion stops at pairs, giving H=N*C_d−P*L_d with the stated conditioned-coordinate incomplete-beta lens integral, whereas a<=t<=1 gives N*C_d. At a−eps, local coordinates p=eps*x, z=sqrt(eps)*y turn lens into |x|/2+(a/2)||y||²<=1; normalized area integrates to B_d eps^{d/2}, B_d=8 κ_(d−2)/(d²κ_d)*(4/sqrt3)^((d−2)/2). For d=3 upper tail 6(1−t). Independently enumerated all directed-root inner products and eligible triples for d=3..7. All-dimensional conclusion is analytic, not experimental.
